name: Fluctuate
summary: Fluctuate is a mean reversion EA that trades based on price fluctuation deviations from a central moving average. It enters positions when price deviates significantly from the mean and exits when price reverts back toward the average. The EA employs a systematic approach with configurable deviation thresholds for entry and exit signals.
summary_zh: Fluctuate是一个基于价格波动偏离均值的均值回归EA。当价格显著偏离均值时开仓，当价格回归均值时平仓。该EA采用系统化方法，具有可配置的偏离阈值用于入场和出场信号。
strategy_analysis: Fluctuate EA的核心策略是均值回归，即假设价格在偏离均值后会回归到平均水平。入场条件是价格偏离移动均线达到设定的阈值时开仓，买入在价格低于均线一定偏差时触发，卖出在价格高于均线一定偏差时触发。出场条件是价格回归到均线附近或达到止盈止损水平时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的下单方式。资金管理方面，EA通过可配置的止损和止盈参数控制每笔交易的风险回报比。整体策略逻辑清晰，但均值回归策略在趋势行情中可能遭遇连续亏损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Fluctuate EA is mean reversion, assuming that price will revert to the mean after significant deviation. Entry conditions trigger when price deviates from the moving average beyond a configured threshold — buying when price falls below the mean by a set deviation and selling when price rises above it. Exit conditions are met when price reverts back toward the moving average or hits take-profit/stop-loss levels. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or equity-proportional sizing based on configurable parameters. Money management is handled through configurable stop-loss and take-profit settings that control the risk-reward ratio for each trade. While the strategy logic is clear, mean reversion strategies can suffer consecutive losses during strong trending markets.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于均值回归的统计原理，有理论基础
参数可配置性强，用户可根据不同品种和时间周期调整偏差阈值和均线周期
设有止损止盈参数，单笔交易风险可控
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on mean reversion statistical principles with solid theoretical foundation
Highly configurable parameters allowing users to adjust deviation thresholds and MA periods for different instruments and timeframes
Includes stop-loss and take-profit settings, keeping per-trade risk manageable
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势行情中容易连续亏损，缺乏趋势过滤机制
未发现新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
缺乏点差过滤，在短线交易时可能因高点差导致入场成本过高
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy is vulnerable to consecutive losses during strong trending markets, lacking trend filtering mechanism
No new bar check detected, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar
Lacks spread filter, which can lead to excessive entry costs during high-spread conditions for short-term trades
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如大周期均线方向判断），避免在强趋势行情中逆势开仓
添加新K线检查和点差过滤机制，提高交易的健壮性
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., higher timeframe MA direction) to avoid counter-trend entries during strong trending markets
Implement new bar check and spread filter mechanisms to improve trading robustness

risk_points: 均值回归策略在趋势行情中存在逆势交易风险，可能造成连续亏损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同一K线内重复开仓增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Mean reversion strategy carries counter-trend trading risk during trending markets, potentially causing consecutive losses
Lack of new bar check may lead to repeated position openings within the same bar, increasing risk exposure
